title: Verifier-style checks
description:
Catch memory bugs the way Driver Verifier's pool tracking does.

```
alloc A 64 'XnEc'
free A          -> ok
free A again    -> VIOLATION: double free of A
free B 'XnLg' with tag 'XnEc' -> VIOLATION: tag mismatch
unload with 1 block alive -> VIOLATION: leak of 128 bytes 'XnLg'
```
hints: Check `m_freed` before `m_live` in `free`, to tell a double free from a pointer that was never allocated (lesson 5.01).
Verifier's special pool goes further, placing each block at the end of a page so an overrun faults at once.
requirements: Track live blocks by id with size and tag; freed ids are remembered to detect double frees.
Report each violation with what happened and the block's tag.
stretch: Inject failures: make every 10th allocation fail and check that the code copes.
